purpose: Inventory of WLEP references in current/live protocol artifacts; classification gates which refs may be renamed and which must remain as historical WLEP provenance.

exclusions: build artifacts under llama.cpp* and exllamav3 (unrelated)

classification_legend.HISTORICAL_IMMUTABLE: Frozen WLEP campaign evidence, frozen snapshot manifest, historical contract files whose SHA-256 is in a published campaign manifest. Rename is FORBIDDEN.
classification_legend.LIVE_PROTOCOL: Living/draft protocol docs, current generic tooling, future templates, repo-candidate description. Migration to WELP is in scope.
classification_legend.COMPATIBILITY_REFERENCE: References that legitimately cite a historical WLEP artifact (e.g. wlep-next-snapshot-2026-08-26-post-apodex). Must remain accurate but DO NOT block rename of living protocol text.
classification_legend.FALSE_POSITIVE: Hits inside literal strings, identifiers, code, or URLs that are not natural-language WLEP references (e.g. WLEP-CONFORMANCE.md inside a historical campaign root is HISTORICAL_IMMUTABLE; a substring like 'wlep-apodex' inside an OMP profile alias is HISTORICAL).
